_comment: Apps the hub offers. pack-apps zips each one into a verified package and writes the catalog.
hubNotes: Beta: Saw Forge Studio 1.1 adds Session Pianist, a physically modelled piano with a virtual session pianist and a Chord Composer. Updating from 1.0.0 or 1.0.1 shows the setup wizard one last time: click Next through it.

apps.name: Saw Forge Studio
apps.description: Arrange, record and mix with the Saw Forge wavetable synth, Worship Atmospheres pads, the Session Pianist (beta), virtual EDM drummers, take comping and automation.
apps.notes: Beta: Session Pianist. A physically modelled piano (five pianos, no samples, sustain-pedal resonance), a virtual pianist with 8 personalities and 12 styles that jams with your chords and the Drummer, and a Chord Composer that writes progressions and full song parts. Add it from Browser, Instruments.

comingSoon.name: More Saw Forge apps
comingSoon.description: New instruments and tools will appear here and install with one click.
